Please solve this issue: Customers sometimes get their shipping fee back after a late delivery; the support team handles these. Add `refund_shipping(payment, amount, at)` to `ledgerly/adjustments.py`: it refunds `amount` of a captured payment, adding it to `payment.refunded_amount` and setting the status to `"refunded"` once everything has been refunded. Return the payment. The amount must be positive and the total refunded may not exceed the captured amount.

## Notes from earlier work
These notes were distilled from earlier work in this repository that passed verification. Follow them unless the code or CHANGELOG.md shows they no longer hold.
- [at-0007] Refunds above 500.00 need approved_by: Per finance policy FIN-2026-03, support-initiated refunds and credits above 500.00 require a second approver: accept keyword-only `approved_by=None` and raise `BillingError("approval_required")` when the amount exceeds the threshold and no approver is given. from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal
from ledgerly.adjustments import refund_shipping
from ledgerly.models import Payment
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError

p=Payment("p","i",Decimal("100.00"),status="captured",captured_at=T)

refund_shipping(Payment("p","i",Decimal("1000.00"),status="captured"),Decimal("501.00"),T,approved_by="mgr")

EOF"}
